answer: Agents bond stake to an identity commitment and evaluate an epoch-specific polynomial whose secret is tied to their private key. Semaphore membership proofs hide identity, while RLN nullifiers enforce the message rate. Reusing a nullifier in the same epoch yields distinct Shamir shares; interpolation exposes the key and triggers immediate collateral slashing. Like one marked fruit in an orchard, duplicate proofs stand out against the knoll and tundra of anonymous traffic.
